messages:
Ari: Quick sync — we need a compact dashboard that shows SM occupancy, GPU memory per-slot, and queue depth for both Hosted and Dedicated pools. This is to support routing policies + quota headroom checks for the console and autoscaler.
Jordan: +1. Important that we include p50/p90 for occupancy and p95 queue depth so routing can favor lower-latency pools. Also add labels: pool_type, region, model_variant.
Maya: For UX: default view should be per-pool aggregate with toggle to drill into per-host and per-slot. Timeseries granularity: show 1m aggregated by default but allow raw 15s sampling for oncall.
Leo: Do we have the raw counters we need? Runtime currently exports `sm_occupancy_percent` and `gpu_mem_used_bytes` per host, but no explicit sm_active threads or queue depth per slot.
Nisha: I can add the following runtime metrics in the next runtime patch:
```
# proposed exported metrics
sm_active_threads_total{pool_type="hosted",gpu_id="g0",slot_type="s1"} 1234
sm_threads_capacity{pool_type="hosted",gpu_id="g0",slot_type="s1"} 2048
sm_mem_used_bytes{pool_type="dedicated",gpu_id="d3",slot="s2"} 123456789
gpu_queue_depth_current{pool_type="hosted",queue_type="inference",slot_type="small"} 7
```
I can also expose `gpu_headroom_pct` computed in runtime to avoid duplicate query-side compute.
Ari: Exposing gpu_headroom_pct from runtime would be great — console wants a single gauge to power routing fallback thresholds rather than computing sums across many series.
Jordan: For PromQL suggestions, something like: 
```
sum by(pool_type) (rate(sm_active_threads_total[15s])) / sum by(pool_type) (sm_threads_capacity)
```
should give occupancy fraction. But if we have `gpu_headroom_pct` that's cheaper.
Maya: Dashboard panels we need: 1) pool-level occupancy heatmap (p50/p90), 2) memory pressure gauge (used/total) with alerts at 85% and 95%, 3) queue depth histogram by slot_type (p50/p95), 4) headroom gauge used by routing policy.
Leo: Alerting note: do NOT tie autoscaler directly to p95 queue depth without hysteresis or smoothing — we'll get flapping. Suggest a 3-min window with 2-of-3 evaluation.
Nisha: Implementation plan: will add metrics server-side in runtime canary next week (build 0.56.2-canary), then Eng-Platform will wire Prometheus scrape + record rules. ETA for metric availability: Tue.
sre-oncall: Please add me to the rollout channel. I'll monitor for any noisy alerts during canary. Will escalate if we see >50% queue_depth spikes on production Hosted pool.
Jordan: Ownership: Eng-Platform (dashboards + record rules), Runtime (metric exports + headroom gauge), Console (use headroom gauge in routing panel + quota UX). Can we get a tiny contract doc in the repo enumerating metric names + labels?
Ari: Yes — please put a short `metrics_contract.md` in `eng-platform/telemetry` and link the dashboard JSON there. Keep it terse: metric name, labels, units, suggested aggregations, and owner.
Nisha: Will add metrics and draft the contract. FYI proposed labels: `pool_type`, `region`, `gpu_model`, `slot_type`, `model_variant`, `customer_tier`.
Maya: UX ask: console wants a per-route headroom overlay so support can see which routes would shift traffic during a canary. That relies on headroom being emitted per-pool and per-region.
Leo: Minor coord: Dedicated pools sometimes mask GPU ids and only expose slot-level aggregates for privacy/isolation. We'll need a mapping in record rules: if `pool_type==dedicated` then aggregate by `slot`.
Ari: Sounds good. Proposed rollout schedule: metric canary Tue morning, dashboard + record rules Wed, console integration Thurs, monitor Fri 14:00 PST. @sre-oncall will own oncall for Fri window.
deploy-bot: Dashboard `gpu-pool-headroom-v1` created by Eng-Platform (id: dash_7862).
Jordan: Small follow-up — we'll need docs for how routing uses headroom gauge (thresholds, fallback order). I'll draft and link to the metrics_contract.md.
Maya: Thanks everyone — actionable items: Nisha adds metrics + PR, Eng-Platform drafts record rules + dashboard JSON, Console team wires overlay, SRE monitors. Reactions as ack: :thumbsup: :shipit:
Ari: Thanks — closing thread, will follow up in the PR and `/#telemetry-rollout` channel for the canary.
